verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is an observability SaaS that ships AI features such as Query Assistant and an MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out. The axis therefore applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a policy, setting, or opt-out that keeps customer telemetry out of AI model training. EU/NA region selection is a data-residency control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
